facts.text: All first-year students at Pomona are required to take an interdisciplinary Critical Inquiry seminar during their first semester.

sources.title: Critical Inquiry Seminar (ID1) - Pomona College
sources.quote: Critical Inquiry seminars, also known as ID1, are required for first-year students in their first semester at the College.

facts.text: Ninety-four percent of Pomona students choose to live on campus for all four years.

sources.title: Life at Pomona | Pomona College in Claremont, California
sources.quote: Ninety-four percent of our students live on campus all four years, and many professors live within five miles of campus.
